title: Fixed-step simulation loop
details: Разделить логику симуляции и рендеринга в main.py. Сделать фиксированный timestep для симуляции, независимый от FPS.
notes: Implemented fixed-step simulation loop. Added FIXED_DT=1/60s and MAX_FRAME_SKIP=5 to config.py. Modified main.py to use accumulator pattern: real time is accumulated and simulation runs in fixed dt steps. All simulation operations now use FIXED_DT instead of variable dt. Tests pass.
